tips.title: Use a precision caliper to measure model dimensions
tips.text: A precision caliper is essential for accurately measuring small model dimensions. It helps to identify scaling errors and ensures that the model is built to the correct proportions.

tips.title: Apply a thin layer of varnish to prevent dust buildup
tips.text: Applying a thin layer of varnish on the model's surface helps to prevent dust and debris from accumulating, which can lead to paint scratches and damage during transport. Choose a varnish specifically designed for scale models.

tips.title: Invest in a dust-free workspace with a HEPA air purifier
tips.text: A dust-free workspace is crucial for scale model building. A HEPA air purifier helps to remove 99.97% of particles as small as 0.3 microns, reducing the risk of dust contamination and ensuring a cleaner work environment.

tips.title: Use a digital level to ensure perfectly horizontal and vertical surfaces
tips.text: A digital level is a must-have tool for any serious scale model builder. It helps to achieve perfectly horizontal and vertical surfaces, ensuring that the model's components are properly aligned and that the final product looks professional.

tips.title: Practice micro-soldering techniques for delicate details
tips.text: Micro-soldering techniques are essential for adding delicate details to scale models. Use a soldering iron with a fine tip and practice using a magnifying glass or a microscope to achieve precise soldering results.
